description: Hauteurs d'eau constatées lors d'inondations et reconnaissances sapeur-pompier dans le Var is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of water heights observed during floods in the department of Var by feedback of intervention experience as well as recognition points carried out by firefighters before and during floods. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water levels observed during floods and firefighter reconnaissance in the Var" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondation, retex, pompier, hauteur, eau, reconnaissance. The listing shows 2018-08-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
